subject: Operator audit export — retention window, manifest format, and delivery options
messages:
From: Evan Mills <evan.mills@blueharbor.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security-requests@blueharbor.io
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — admin activity export (format + retention)

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing the SIG/SOC2 package for our security board meeting and need a concise description and a sample of Redwood's admin-activity export for operator actions. Specifically:  
- What events are included in the archive (privileged role changes, console actions, API key ops, assumption tokens, session starts/stops, operator impersonation, etc.)?
- Retention windows: default retention for admin events, and available retention-by-policy options for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Export delivery options: signed manifest with checksum (preferable), streaming S3-compatible endpoint, or timeboxed on-demand bundle. Which do you support and which do you recommend for attestation?

Could you also provide a small sample manifest and a CSV or schema we can hand to the audit team? We're on a tight timeline — meeting is 2026-09-21.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Mills
Senior Audit Engineer, Blue Harbor Security

From: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
To: Evan Mills <evan.mills@blueharbor.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (format + retention)

Evan — thanks for the clear ask. High level answers first, then I'll attach a sample manifest and schema.

What we log (high level):
- Privileged role assignments and revocations (actor, target, role, prior_role, timestamp)
- Console actions (sign-in attempts, session creation/termination, console UI actions that trigger state changes)
- API key lifecycle (create, rotate, revoke) and service principal operations
- Operator impersonation / assume-role events with originating session/IKV reference
- Admin config changes (policy toggles, retention changes, routing/fallback changes)
- Model-serving control plane actions (deploy, rollback, scale events) that affect customer data handling policies
- Audit ingestion and export actions (who requested export, scope, checksum, delivery URL)

Retention:
- Default (hosted): 365 days for admin activity; 90 days for short-term ephemeral ops telemetry (configurable by plan)
- Dedicated / Private: customers can request retention windows up to 7 years via contract; we provide RBAC for retention policy changes and an attestation of policy enforcement.

Delivery options we support and recommendations:
1) Signed manifest + S3 PUT (recommended for attestation): we provide a gzipped bundle with a signed manifest (SHA256) and a detached signature (PKCS7) or signed S3 presigned URL. This is the standard for SOC2/SIG evidence handoffs.
2) On-demand timeboxed bundle (HTTPS download): for small windows or for customers behind restrictive egress controls.
3) Streaming real-time feed to customer-owned collector (Kafka/S3/HTTP): for long-running attestations, but requires customer infra and an initial handshake.

I'll attach: admin_activity_sample_manifest_v1.json and export_schema_v1.csv.

Action items:
- Evan: let us know which delivery you prefer and the time window you want for the sample (we can produce a 7-day bundle for testing).
- Laura / Soojin: can you confirm whether we have an existing presigned-s3 example in the public drive and any redaction/sampling notes I should call out to Blue Harbor?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Compliance & Observability
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (format + retention)

Karthik — quick note. We have a presigned S3 sample and a signed-manifest example in the Drive folder (link below). A couple of clarifications to include in the reply to Evan:
- Redaction: by default we redact IP addresses and session tokens in bundles; PII fields are flagged and can be further redacted on request. Call out that redaction is logged and reversible with an internal access request (for on-prem customers we can provide unredacted under NDAs).
- Sampling: large tenants can request either a full export (longer SLA) or sampled slices with an attested manifest that includes sampling criteria. Sampling criteria are included in the manifest metadata.
- Checksum: we always include SHA256 and an HMAC signature tied to the export job id; for attestation packages we also include a notarized PKCS7 signature.

I'll attach the Drive link in my reply; Soojin, flag anything else I missed about the on-prem delivery nuances.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
To: Evan Mills <evan.mills@blueharbor.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com, soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (format + retention)

Evan — following up with the sample files attached and clarifications inline. Attached: admin_activity_sample_manifest_v1.json (small 48-hour example) and export_schema_v1.csv (column definitions). Short answers to your bullets again below.

Events included (representative): role.change, api_key.create, api_key.revoke, session.start, session.end, impersonation.assume, config.update, export.request, export.complete. Each event has actor_id, actor_email (redacted for hosted customers by default), target_id, resource_type, timestamp (ISO8601 UTC), request_id, job_id, and a checksum pointer for any binary artifacts.

Retention: hosted default 365 days; Dedicated or Private contractual options up to 7 years. We support legal-hold tagging to extend retention per-customer for active investigations.

Delivery options: signed-manifest + gz bundle to S3 (recommended), HTTPS timeboxed download, or streaming feed. For SOC2 attestation we recommend signed-manifest + PKCS7.

Next steps:
- Pick delivery option (reply here) and we'll produce a 7-day bundle and run a verification checklist.
- If you want on-prem unredacted fields, sign the NDA and we'll route through legal.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Compliance & Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_sample_manifest_v1.json (48-hour example), export_schema_v1.csv (field defs).
